dockerfile_findings.title: Missing HEALTHCHECK instruction
dockerfile_findings.description: No HEALTHCHECK instruction was found. Without a healthcheck, orchestrators cannot detect unhealthy containers.
dockerfile_findings.recommendation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction appropriate for your service, e.g.: HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD curl -f http://localhost/ || exit 1
